reports.text:
OPEN
North Entrance to SR123/Cayuse Pass then east to Chinook Pass
For pass information, check the Washington State Dept. of Transportation (WSDOT) or call 1-800-695-ROAD (7623) toll-free statewide or 206-DOT-HIWY (368-4499) in the greater Seattle area.
Commercial vehicles prohibited at all times.

facts.text: Snow left 3 nearby stations 13 to 23 days earlier this year than the median of the three earlier seasons on file (2023 to 2025).

evidence.name: Cayuse Pass
evidence.detail: left May 20; earlier seasons: June 8 (2023), June 16 (2024), June 12 (2025)

evidence.name: Morse Lake
evidence.detail: left May 26; earlier seasons: June 13 (2023), June 23 (2024), June 18 (2025)

evidence.name: Bumping Ridge
evidence.detail: left May 6; earlier seasons: May 19 (2023), May 18 (2024), May 22 (2025)

facts.text: This year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was the lowest of the four seasons on file (2023 to 2026) at all 3 nearby stations.

evidence.name: Cayuse Pass
evidence.detail: 29.8 in on April 2; earlier seasons: 62.5 in (2023), 40.1 in (2024), 65.4 in (2025)

evidence.name: Morse Lake

evidence.name: Bumping Ridge

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between April 30 and June 17, carried from the melt-out dates at 3 nearby stations to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Cayuse Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 20, 170 ft below the pass; points to April 30 to June 15

evidence.name: Morse Lake
evidence.detail: melted out May 26, at the pass elevation; points to May 5 to June 17

evidence.name: Bumping Ridge
evidence.detail: melted out May 6, 830 ft below the pass; points to April 23 to June 17
